selection.reason: Nearest pixel to Termez (2.7 km away, inside UZ-SU) whose 1 km MCD12Q1 2025 window is mostly class 12 (Croplands, 10/25 pixels) and whose July–August NDVI reached 0.71 (composite of 2024-07-11); 1 candidate(s) checked.
